problem: Selling a home is slow and uncertain; Ivy makes instant offers, refurbishes and resells via channel partners.
business_model: iBuying: buy, refurbish and resell homes (spread)

founders.name: Pritam Thakur
founders.background_notes: Previously ran a real estate project in India (YC page).

founders.name: Abhilash Narahari
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder in Inc42; background not found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Pricing model over 80 parameters on about 2.5 million Bengaluru sales records, plus operational work in inspection, legal diligence and refurbishment; standard ML with heavy operations.

defensibility.rationale: Local transaction data helps pricing, but listing portals and well-funded players could assemble data; capital and operations are the real barrier.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent was found launching an iBuying product in India in sources reached; US iBuyer Opendoor closed its India offices in 2026, but those were back-office, not a market entry.

market_need_then: Founders argue selling a home in India is slow and stressful; Inc42 cites an Indian real estate market projected to grow from $200 Bn in 2021 to $1 Tn by 2030. Demand evidence beyond the company claim was not found.

branding.domain_note: Uses ivy.homes (a .homes TLD), per company site.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand itself; search results are crowded with unrelated Ivy home businesses.

outcome_analysis: Ivy Homes is a Summer 2021 iBuyer for Bengaluru that raised about $7M in June 2022 (USD 5.75M equity plus 1.3M debt) and still operates. No later round, exit or shutdown was found, and the balance-sheet heavy model carries inventory risk that sources do not yet show succeeding or failing, so no outcome factors are assigned.
notes: Directory Active, consistent. CB Insights labels the 2022-06 $5.75M round Series A; press says seed, recorded as seed. A profile site claims $6.25M total and $907K revenue (Mar 2024), unverified and not recorded. No funding after 2022-06 found; coverage partial. Founding year varies by source (2019 vs 2021); 2021 used. Competitor list comes from the Inc42 article dated 2022-06, one year after the batch; no dated 2021 competitor source found. Name origin not found.
